result.title: MPIG: Multi-angle Polarization Image Generation from a Single Polarization Observation
result.summary: Polarization imaging provides informative cues for material analysis, scene understanding, and visual perception. However, acquiring complete polarization observations typically requires specialized hardware and multi-angle measurements, thereby increasing system complexity and limiting practical deployment. In this work, we address the problem of predicting the missing $45^\circ$, $90^\circ$, and $135^\circ$ polarization views from a single $0^\circ$ observation by leveraging a learned scene prior. To this end, we propose MPIG (Multi-angle Polarization Image Generation), a Swin Transformer-based framework that couples cross-angle feature interaction with residual decoding to predict angle-dependent intensity variations while preserving shared scene structure. Specifically, measured Stokes differences and polarization-strength-aware supervision guide the recovery of polarization modulation, orientation, and magnitude, while low-rank factorization further reduces the decoding cost. We also construct HighPol, a large-scale real-world polarization dataset comprising 5,474 groups of high-resolution four-angle polarization images collected from diverse indoor and outdoor scenes. Experimental results demonstrate improved image and polarization accuracy, achieving 29.729 dB PSNR, 0.9505 SSIM, and $21.514^\circ$ AoLP MAngE while requiring 85.86 M parameters and 1.126 T FLOPs. Furthermore, downstream validation on glass and semantic-segmentation tasks suggests that the generated polarization images can preserve task-relevant information, demonstrating the effectiveness of MPIG and the practical utility of predicted polarization observations for downstream vision applications.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 MPIG，用 Swin Transformer 从单张 0° 偏振观测预测 45°、90°、135° 三个角度的偏振图像，并构建四角度偏振图像数据集 HighPol，以 PSNR/SSIM/AoLP 等指标评估生成质量及下游玻璃与分割任务表现。
AI.relevance_reason: 属于偏振图像的成像补全与图像生成工作，目标是恢复像素级观测而非多模态推理状态，未涉及 latent 推理、证据获取、停止决策或推理期计算分配，缺失视角预测虽与「补全视觉细节」字面相近，但并无可供 LVR 核查的状态或训练线索。
